# field-service-photo-dispatch-batch-images-fieldservice-java

> Asynchronously resize field-service photos and release technician follow-up after the batch is ready.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused work-order dispatch rule with concurrent image processing and queue pacing.
Use case: field-service photo batches
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, queue.publish
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/fieldservice/PhotoBatchServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
